qa_pair.question: Search for components that support validation states (invalid, disabled, or required props). Among these, which component has the most slots available for customization? Provide only the component name.
Find all components in the Form Components category. Count how many of them emit an 'update:modelValue' event. What is the count?
Look up the design token used for medium border radius. What is the exact pixel value defined for this token? Provide only the number without 'px'.

Search for components that have a 'color' prop. Among those components, which one supports the most color variant options? Count the distinct color values in the options array and provide the component name that has the highest count.
Find the design token category that contains the most individual tokens. What is the category name?
Get information about the LbButton component. How many different variant options does it support? Provide only the number.
Search for typography-related tokens. Among font weight tokens, what is the numerical value (as a string) of the 'semibold' font weight?
Find components that include 'icon' in their slot names. Which component category do the majority of these components belong to? Answer with the exact category name.
Look up spacing tokens. What is the pixel value of the largest spacing size (10xl)? Provide only the number without 'px'.

Search for components that have a 'variant' prop. Count how many unique variant values exist across all these components (counting each unique string only once, regardless of which component it appears in). What is the total count?
